testSmells.title: Magic Literals
testSmells.message:
It has an excessive use of literals. This can cause severe problems:

- Too many literals are distracting and obfuscate the functionality and purpose of a test. This makes a test hard to read and understand.

- The same or similar test data is often repeated within a test or test-suite. This is often a consequence of simply extending or adding tests without actually designing them. The result is a test-suite that is extremely hard to maintain and refactor.

testSmells.title: Improper Organization
testSmells.message:
It does not have a Proper Organization.

Tests should have the following structure:

- Arrange: This is where you initialize objects and set the value of the data to be passed to the function under test.

- Act: The act section invokes the function under test.

- Assert: This is where you verify that the action of the function under test behaves as expected.

So asserts should be together at the end of the test.

mentorFindings.name: One initialize message doing only assignments
mentorFindings.title: One initialize message doing only assignments: BoundedStack>>initialize: does more than assignments
mentorFindings.detail: The method BoundedStack>>initialize: does more than assignments; an initialize message only assigns instance variables, aside from an optional super initialize.

mentorFindings.detail: The method BoundedStack class>>new: does not follow the heuristic: An instance creation message runs its preconditions, each as a self assert... send, and then answers ^self new initialize...

methods.source:
pop
	| result |
	top = 0
		ifTrue: [ self error: 'stack is empty' ].
	result := items at: top.
	top := top - 1.
	^ result

push: anObject
	top >= capacity
		ifTrue: [ self error: 'stack is full' ].
	top := top + 1.
	items at: top put: anObject

top
	top = 0
		ifTrue: [ self error: 'stack is empty' ].
	^ items at: top

isEmpty
	^ top = 0

size
	^ top

initialize: aCapacity
	(aCapacity isInteger and: [ aCapacity > 0 ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'capacity must be a positive integer' ].
	capacity := aCapacity.
	items := Array new: aCapacity.
	top := 0

new: aCapacity
	| instance |
	instance := self new.
	instance initialize: aCapacity.
	^ instance

setUp
	stack := BoundedStack new: 3

testPushAndSize
	self assert: stack size = 0.
	stack push: 'a'.
	self assert: stack size = 1.
	stack push: 'b'.
	self assert: stack size = 2.
	stack push: 'c'.
	self assert: stack size = 3

testCreateStackWithStringCapacityFails
	| errorRaised |
	errorRaised := false.
	[ BoundedStack new: 'five' ] on: Error do: [ :e | errorRaised := true ].
	self assert: errorRaised

testPushOnFullStackRaisesError
	| errorRaised errorMessage |
	stack push: 'a'.
	stack push: 'b'.
	stack push: 'c'.
	errorRaised := false.
	errorMessage := ''.
	[ stack push: 'd' ] on: Error do: [ :e |
		errorRaised := true.
		errorMessage := e messageText ].
	self assert: errorRaised.
	self assert: errorMessage = 'stack is full'

testCreateStackWithFloatCapacityFails
	| errorRaised |
	errorRaised := false.
	[ BoundedStack new: 3.5 ] on: Error do: [ :e | errorRaised := true ].
	self assert: errorRaised

testPopOnEmptyStackRaisesError
	| errorRaised errorMessage |
	errorRaised := false.
	errorMessage := ''.
	[ stack pop ] on: Error do: [ :e |
		errorRaised := true.
		errorMessage := e messageText ].
	self assert: errorRaised.
	self assert: errorMessage = 'stack is empty'

testDifferentObjectTypes
	stack := BoundedStack new: 5.
	stack push: 42.
	stack push: 'string'.
	stack push: #symbol.
	stack push: (Array with: 1 with: 2).
	self assert: stack pop = (Array with: 1 with: 2).
	self assert: stack pop = #symbol.
	self assert: stack pop = 'string'.
	self assert: stack pop = 42

testLargeCapacity
	| s errorRaised |
	s := BoundedStack new: 100.
	1 to: 100 do: [ :i | s push: i ].
	self assert: s size = 100.
	self assert: s top = 100.
	errorRaised := false.
	[ s push: 101 ] on: Error do: [ :e | errorRaised := true ].
	self assert: errorRaised

testCreateStackWithValidCapacity
	| s |
	s := BoundedStack new: 5.
	self assert: s isEmpty.
	self assert: s size = 0

testCreateStackWithZeroCapacityFails
	| errorRaised errorMessage |
	errorRaised := false.
	errorMessage := ''.
	[ BoundedStack new: 0 ] on: Error do: [ :e |
		errorRaised := true.
		errorMessage := e messageText ].
	self assert: errorRaised.
	self assert: errorMessage = 'capacity must be a positive integer'

testTop
	stack push: 'a'.
	stack push: 'b'.
	self assert: stack top = 'b'.
	self assert: stack size = 2

testTopOnEmptyStackRaisesError
	| errorRaised errorMessage |
	errorRaised := false.
	errorMessage := ''.
	[ stack top ] on: Error do: [ :e |
		errorRaised := true.
		errorMessage := e messageText ].
	self assert: errorRaised.
	self assert: errorMessage = 'stack is empty'

testPopRemovesElement
	stack push: 'first'.
	stack push: 'second'.
	stack pop.
	self assert: stack top = 'first'

testSizeDecrementsOnPop
	stack push: 1.
	stack push: 2.
	stack push: 3.
	stack pop.
	self assert: stack size = 2.
	stack pop.
	self assert: stack size = 1.
	stack pop.
	self assert: stack size = 0

testMixedOperations
	stack push: 10.
	self assert: stack top = 10.
	stack push: 20.
	self assert: stack size = 2.
	self assert: stack pop = 20.
	self assert: stack top = 10.
	self assert: stack size = 1.
	stack push: 30.
	stack push: 40.
	self assert: stack size = 3.
	self assert: stack pop = 40.
	self assert: stack pop = 30.
	self assert: stack pop = 10.
	self assert: stack isEmpty

testSizeIncrementsOnPush
	self assert: stack size = 0.
	stack push: 1.
	self assert: stack size = 1.
	stack push: 2.
	self assert: stack size = 2.
	stack push: 3.
	self assert: stack size = 3

testStackWithCapacityOne
	| s errorRaised |
	s := BoundedStack new: 1.
	self assert: s isEmpty.
	s push: 'only'.
	self assert: s size = 1.
	self assert: s top = 'only'.
	errorRaised := false.
	[ s push: 'another' ] on: Error do: [ :e | errorRaised := true ].
	self assert: errorRaised.
	self assert: s pop = 'only'.
	self assert: s isEmpty

testLIFOBehavior
	stack push: 'first'.
	stack push: 'second'.
	stack push: 'third'.
	self assert: stack pop = 'third'.
	self assert: stack pop = 'second'.
	self assert: stack pop = 'first'

testTopDoesNotRemove
	stack push: 'x'.
	stack push: 'y'.
	self assert: stack top = 'y'.
	self assert: stack top = 'y'.
	self assert: stack size = 2

testPop
	stack push: 'a'.
	stack push: 'b'.
	stack push: 'c'.
	self assert: stack pop = 'c'.
	self assert: stack size = 2.
	self assert: stack pop = 'b'.
	self assert: stack size = 1.
	self assert: stack pop = 'a'.
	self assert: stack size = 0

testIsEmpty
	self assert: stack isEmpty.
	stack push: 'something'.
	self assert: stack isEmpty not.
	stack pop.
	self assert: stack isEmpty

testCreateStackWithNegativeCapacityFails
	| errorRaised errorMessage |
	errorRaised := false.
	errorMessage := ''.
	[ BoundedStack new: -1 ] on: Error do: [ :e |
		errorRaised := true.
		errorMessage := e messageText ].
	self assert: errorRaised.
	self assert: errorMessage = 'capacity must be a positive integer'
